r: The great Savoyard classic: soft potatoes, bacon lardons and a reblochon that melts and browns.
Boil the whole potatoes in salted water for 20 min.|Cooking|20
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the potatoes into slices.
Fry the sliced onions and the lardons in a pan for 8 min, then pour in the white wine.|Pan|8
In a dish, layer potatoes, lardons and cream. Place the reblochon on top, cut in half, rind up.
Bake for 25 min, until nicely golden.|Oven|25
The cream is replaced with fromage blanc and the reblochon is halved.
All the indulgence of tartiflette, but lighter for a weekday.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 min.|Cooking|20
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the potatoes into slices.
Fry the sliced onions with the ham in a pan for 5 min.|Pan|5
Mix the fromage blanc with salt and pepper, then stir in the potatoes, onion and ham.
Pour into a dish, add half a reblochon in slices and bake for 25 min.|Oven|25
The lardons are replaced with well-browned mushrooms.
Golden mushrooms instead of lardons: the reblochon does the rest.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 min.|Cooking|20
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the potatoes into slices.
Brown the sliced mushrooms and the onions in a pan for 10 min.|Pan|10
Layer potatoes, mushrooms and cream in a dish, then place the reblochon on top, cut in half.
